purpose: Prioritize exact lexical gaps for visual curation without inflating usable coverage before naming evidence exists.

policy.exactness: Every candidate is tied to the same complete IPA as the target sound.
policy.evidenceTiers: Editorial prototype decisions are listed first. Uncurated exact Lexique words remain lexical prechecks, not visual hypotheses.
policy.rejection: Previously rejected or deferred candidate/IPA pairs are excluded.
policy.reuse: An existing asset is surfaced only when its stored whole-word IPA is exactly the same as the target sound.
policy.symbols: Single-letter lexical artifacts are excluded from image curation because visible-letter conventions are modeled separately.
policy.namability: Noun status is only a research prioritization hint. It never means visually obvious or validated.
policy.activation: Nothing in this file activates a pictogram automatically.
